location_policy.crs_basis: CMS publishes latitude and longitude of the facility address; rendered as longitude/latitude without geocoding or datum conversion.
location_policy.mapped: valid latitude/longitude and blank geocoding footnote
location_policy.excluded_footnote_22: CMS says the street address could not be matched; coordinates are based on the ZIP code and are excluded from points.
location_policy.never: No missing coordinates are geocoded and no ZIP or county centroid is substituted.

footnotes.1: Newly certified nursing home with less than 12-15 months of data available or opened less than 6 months ago, with no data to submit or claims for this measure.
footnotes.2: Not enough data available to calculate a star rating.
footnotes.18: Not rated due to a history of serious quality issues; included in the special focus facility program.
footnotes.20: The accuracy of the data for this rating could not be validated by CMS.
footnotes.22: The street address could not be matched to latitude/longitude; coordinates are based on the ZIP code.
footnotes.23: The facility did not submit staffing data.
footnotes.24: The facility reported a high number of days without a registered nurse onsite.
footnotes.25: The accuracy of the staffing data for this measure could not be validated by CMS.

limitations: CMS star ratings are published measures, not a guarantee of individual care or a live assessment.
Certified beds are federally certified capacity, not currently vacant beds.
Ratings and their underlying inspection, staffing, and quality-measure periods may differ; the processing date is not a common observation year.
Facilities with ZIP-based geocodes or invalid or missing coordinates are retained but excluded from map points.
Each CCN is one published provider row; it need not represent every campus or building of an organization. No ratings are averaged.
